name: Young Sheldon
description: The early life of child genius Sheldon Cooper, later seen in The Big Bang Theory.

videos.title: An Origin Story
videos.overview: Cast and creators share how this show not only explores the backstory of one of television's funniest characters but also his wonderfully hilarious family that helped make Sheldon, well, Sheldon..

videos.title: Sibling Revelry
videos.overview: Iain Armitage (Sheldon), Raegan Revord (Missy), and Montana Jordan (Georgie) sit down together and discuss the fun of being a part of the show playing siblings and their favourite moments from Season One.

videos.title: The Coopers, East Texas, and the 80's
videos.overview: Join the show's cast and design team as they share the processes involved in crafting the look of 1980's Texas and how the period plays an essential storytelling role.

videos.title: Time Flies When You're Having Fun: Young Sheldon at 100
videos.overview: The cast and crew look back at the series after 100 episodes.

videos.title: Sheldon's Secret Origins and Easter Eggs
videos.overview: A behind the scenes look at the series included with the Blu-ray release of the final season.

videos.title: Pilot
videos.overview: 9-year-old Sheldon Cooper is a once-in-a-generation mind capable of advanced mathematics and science but learns that isn’t always helpful growing up in East Texas, a land where church and football are king.

videos.title: Rockets, Communists, and the Dewey Decimal System
videos.overview: To appease his worried mother, Sheldon employs the techniques of a self-help book to try and make a friend.

videos.title: Poker, Faith, and Eggs
videos.overview: When George Sr. is rushed to the emergency room, Connie comes to babysit, and the kids have an adventure getting to the hospital on their own.

videos.title: A Therapist, a Comic Book, and a Breakfast Sausage
videos.overview: After choking on a breakfast sausage, Sheldon wrestles with his fear of solid foods and discovers comic books for the first time.

videos.title: A Solar Calculator, a Game Ball, and a Cheerleader's Bosom
videos.overview: Sheldon struggles with newfound popularity after utilizing statistics to help the football team.

videos.title: A Patch, a Modem, and a Zantac
videos.overview: When a NASA representative visits Sheldon’s school and dismisses his science, Sheldon is set on a mission to prove him wrong.

videos.title: A Brisket, Voodoo, and Cannonball Run
videos.overview: The kids brainstorm ways to resolve a family feud when Connie refuses to give George Sr. her brisket recipe.

videos.title: Cape Canaveral, Schrödinger's Cat, and Cyndi Lauper's Hair
videos.overview: While Mary, Connie and Missy have their girls night at the salon, the three Cooper men plan their road trip to see the space launcher, but it doesn't go as well as they plan.

videos.title: Spock, Kirk, and Testicular Hernia
videos.overview: George Sr. strikes a deal with Sheldon to tutor Georgie when poor grades threaten to keep him from playing football. While Sheldon's tutoring attempts are ultimately unsuccessful, he does learn some skills from his brother.

videos.title: An Eagle Feather, a String Bean, and an Eskimo
videos.overview: When Sheldon moves to Dallas to attend a school for gifted children, the family struggles to cope with his absence.

videos.title: Demons, Sunday School, and Prime Numbers
videos.overview: A worried Mary sends Sheldon to Sunday school after she finds him playing Dungeons and Dragons with his friends, Tam and Billy.

videos.title: A Computer, a Plastic Pony, and a Case of Beer
videos.overview: Sheldon asks for a computer and unknowingly sparks a heated argument between Mary and George Sr. over the family’s finances.

videos.title: A Sneeze, Detention, and Sissy Spacek
videos.overview: When flu season hits Medford, Sheldon takes extreme measures to remain healthy.

videos.title: Potato Salad, a Broomstick, and Dad's Whiskey
videos.overview: When Mary takes a job as church secretary, she finds herself becoming Pastor Jeff's marriage counselor. Also, Sheldon and Missy spend their first afternoon home alone.

videos.title: Dolomite, Apple Slices, and a Mystery Woman
videos.overview: Sheldon makes friends with an upperclassman who introduces him to a new field of science. Also, Mary and George disagree on how to handle Sheldon's blossoming social life.

videos.title: Killer Asteroids, Oklahoma, and a Frizzy Hair Machine
videos.overview: A disappointing loss at the science fair sends Sheldon’s life in a new direction.

videos.title: Jiu-Jitsu, Bubble Wrap, and Yoo-hoo
videos.overview: Sheldon is bullied by an unlikely character, and Mary and George disagree on how to handle the situation.

videos.title: A Mother, A Child, and a Blue Man's Backside
videos.overview: Mary bans Sheldon from reading a mature comic book. Sheldon decides it's time to stop living under Mary's thumb.

videos.title: Gluons, Guacamole, and the Color Purple
videos.overview: When Sheldon is no longer academically challenged at Medford High, he audits a college class taught by Dr. John Sturgis.

videos.title: A Dog, a Squirrel, and a Fish Named Fish
videos.overview: A battle erupts between the Coopers and Sparks when the Sparks' new dog terrorizes Sheldon.

videos.title: Summer Sausage, a Pocket Poncho, and Tony Danza
videos.overview: While Sheldon is busy keeping tabs on Connie’s budding relationship with Dr. Sturgis, George Sr. and Mary attempt to bond with their other children.

videos.title: Vanilla Ice Cream, Gentleman Callers, and a Dinette Set
videos.overview: When Connie is pursued by two gentlemen callers, Sheldon interferes, forcing her to set some ground rules.

videos.title: A High-Pitched Buzz and Training Wheels
videos.overview: After Sheldon dismantles the refrigerator to stop an annoying hum, he gets a paper route to pay for the repairs.

videos.title: A Rival Prodigy and Sir Isaac Neutron
videos.overview: When Dr. Sturgis bonds with Paige, another 10-year-old genius, Sheldon’s jealousy leads Connie to intervene. Mary invites Paige’s family over for a play date.

videos.title: A Crisis of Faith and Octopus Aliens
videos.overview: When Mary’s faith is shaken by a tragedy in the community, Sheldon becomes an unlikely ally.

videos.title: A Financial Secret and Fish Sauce
videos.overview: When George Sr. asks Sheldon to keep a secret from Mary, the stress of not being honest drives Sheldon to hideout at Tam’s for his first sleepover.

videos.title: A Research Study and Czechoslovakian Wedding Pastries
videos.overview: When Dr. Sturgis recommends Sheldon and Missy for a university research study on twins, Mary is unhappy when the test results go to Sheldon's head.

videos.title: Seven Deadly Sins and a Small Carl Sagan
videos.overview: Mary clashes with Sheldon's drama teacher over plans for a Halloween fundraiser for the church. Georgie falls for a rebellious teenage girl whom Sheldon is tutoring.

videos.title: Carbon Dating and a Stuffed Raccoon
videos.overview: Sheldon gets into trouble with fellow child genius, Paige at the science museum. George is forced to play therapist to Paige’s bickering parents. Mary, Georgie and Missy help Connie with a garage sale.

videos.title: An 8-Bit Princess and a Flat Tire Genius
videos.overview: A video game takes over Sheldon and Connie’s life. George Sr. is jealous when Georgie bonds with Herschel at the auto shop.

videos.title: Family Dynamics and a Red Fiero
videos.overview: Sheldon studies his family for a psychology project. Thanksgiving dinner turns into a family fight when George Sr. is offered a job in Oklahoma.

videos.title: A Stunted Childhood and a Can of Fancy Mixed Nuts
videos.overview: When Sheldon learns that people with stunted childhoods can turn into social outcasts, he tries to act. Connie and Dr. Sturgis' relationship is tested when she teaches him how to drive.

videos.title: A Race of Superhumans and a Letter to Alf
videos.overview: Sheldon experiments on Missy, and Georgie joins Mary’s bible study to spend more time with his crush, Veronica.

videos.title: A Tummy Ache and a Whale of a Metaphor
videos.overview: When Sheldon has to spend a few days in the hospital, he turns into the world’s worst patient. Also, Missy gets a taste of what life would be like without her twin.

videos.title: A Nuclear Reactor and a Boy Called Lovely
videos.overview: Sheldon attempts to build a nuclear reactor. Also, a university cocktail party gets heated when Dr. Sturgis’ colleague, Dr. Linkletter, flirts with Connie, and Georgie is heartbroken when he learns Veronica has a boyfriend.

videos.title: David, Goliath and a Yoo-hoo from the Back
videos.overview: Sheldon uses his new friendship with the school bully to boss Georgie around. Also, Missy steals Connie's makeup for picture day.

videos.title: A Math Emergency and Perky Palms
videos.overview: Sheldon and Dr. Sturgis have their first fight when Dr. Sturgis marks a question wrong on Sheldon's test. Also, Mary takes over for Pastor Jeff when he's out sick.

videos.title: A Loaf of Bread and a Grand Old Flag
videos.overview: Things spiral out of control when Sheldon boycotts his favorite bread company. Also, Georgie offers Veronica a shoulder to cry on when she's dumped by her boyfriend.

videos.title: Albert Einstein and the Story of Another Mary
videos.overview: Inspired by his hero, Albert Einstein, Sheldon tries his hand at the violin. Also, Mary and Connie secretly buy a pregnancy test when Mary thinks she's pregnant

videos.title: A Perfect Score and a Bunsen Burner Marshmallow
videos.overview: Sheldon moves in with Dr. Sturgis for the weekend to see what his life will be like in college. Also, a lonely Mary tries to bond with the other Coopers during Sheldon's absence.

videos.title: A Political Campaign and a Candy Land Cheater
videos.overview: Unhappy that school funds are going towards football rather than academics, Sheldon decides to run for class president.

videos.title: A Proposal and a Popsicle Stick Cross
videos.overview: Georgie is thrilled when Veronica stays at the Coopers' house for a few days. Also, Connie and Dr. Sturgis celebrate their one-year anniversary.

videos.title: A Broken Heart and a Crock Monster
videos.overview: The Coopers help Pastor Jeff through a rough patch in his marriage. Also, Sheldon pressures church members for donations when Mary takes him to work for a day.

videos.title: A Swedish Science Thing and the Equation for Toast
videos.overview: Sheldon invites the entire school to a party for the Nobel Prize announcements. Also, Connie learns more about Dr. Sturgis' past, and Georgie's desire for cable TV leads to a standoff between him and George Sr.

videos.title: Quirky Eggheads and Texas Snow Globes
videos.overview: After Dr. Sturgis experiences a nervous breakdown, Mary worries Sheldon is headed down a similar path. Also, Georgie discovers he has a knack for sales.

videos.title: A Broom Closet and Satan's Monopoly Board
videos.overview: Without Dr. Sturgis’ university class, Sheldon must find a new way to stay academically challenged. Also, Mary helps Pastor Jeff avoid temptation with his girlfriend.

videos.title: An Entrepreneurialist and a Swat on the Bottom
videos.overview: Sheldon takes matters into his own hands when Connie refuses to drive him to a lecture with Dr. Linkletter. Also, Georgie tries to impress Veronica with his new business venture

videos.title: Hobbitses, Physicses and a Ball with Zip
videos.overview: Sheldon is forced to take a break from science when his new obsession with "The Lord of the Rings" leads to an unhealthy habit. Also, Missy asks George Sr. to teach her how to play catch.

videos.title: A Pineapple and the Bosom of Male Friendship
videos.overview: After being released from the mental hospital, Dr. Sturgis unexpectedly breaks up with Connie.

videos.title: A Parasol and a Hell of an Arm
videos.overview: A church carnival leads Missy to try out for the baseball team. Also, Connie struggles after her breakup with Dr. Sturgis.

videos.title: Pongo Pygmaeus and a Culture that Encourages Spitting
videos.overview: Sheldon starts an internet flame war, and Missy stands up to the boys on her baseball team. Also, Connie is unhappy when George Sr. spends time with her new boyfriend.

videos.title: The Sin of Greed and a Chimichanga from Chi-chi's
videos.overview: The University makes George Sr. a lucrative job offer in the hopes of recruiting Sheldon. Also, Georgie gets a job working for Connie's new boyfriend, and Mary is determined to rid her home of greed.

videos.title: A Party Invitation, Football Grapes and an Earth Chicken
videos.overview: Mary gets Pastor Jeff involved when Sheldon isn't invited to Billy's birthday party. Also, George Sr. has "male-bonding time" with Dr. Sturgis.

videos.title: Teenager Soup and a Little Ball of Fib
videos.overview: Sheldon fakes being sick to avoid a swim test at school. Also, Dr. Sturgis spies on Connie's new boyfriend.

videos.title: A Live Chicken, a Fried Chicken and Holy Matrimony
videos.overview: George Sr. and Connie struggle to manage the Cooper household while Mary plans Pastor Jeff’s wedding.

videos.title: Body Glitter and a Mall Safety Kit
videos.overview: Sheldon learns to listen when an emotional Paige struggles with her parents’ divorce. George Sr. is furious when Georgie tries to buy his way out of chores.

videos.title: Contracts, Rules and a Little Bit of Pig Brains
videos.overview: George Sr. and Georgie go camping with Connie's new boyfriend, Dale, but things get complicated when her ex-boyfriend, Dr. Sturgis, tags along. Also, Sheldon and Missy invent a super-game.

videos.title: A Slump, a Cross and Roadside Gravel
videos.overview: Sheldon and Georgie mine for platinum in roadside gravel. Mary is concerned when Missy misuses religion to help with a batting slump.

videos.title: A Boyfriend's Ex-Wife and a Good Luck Head Rub
videos.overview: Connie meets Dale’s ex-wife, June. Sheldon is forced to work on a group project with reluctant college students.

videos.title: Pasadena
videos.overview: Sheldon visits CalTech for the very first time. Also, Georgie is furious when Mary listens in on a phone call with his girlfriend, and Connie tries to cheer up a jealous Missy.

videos.title: An Academic Crime and a More Romantic Taco Bell
videos.overview: Dr. Sturgis is furious when Sheldon accuses him of plagiarism. Also, Mary sets out to find a “girl trophy” for Missy’s end-of-season baseball ceremony, and Georgie has an awkward run-in with Veronica while on a date with his new girlfriend, Jana.

videos.title: A Couple Bruised Ribs and a Cereal Box Ghost Detector
videos.overview: When George Sr. accidentally lands the school librarian in the hospital, the Cooper family must nurse her back to health. Connie gives Georgie relationship advice.

videos.title: A House for Sale and Serious Woman Stuff
videos.overview: When Sheldon learns the house next door is for sale, he takes it upon himself to find the perfect neighbors. Missy is torn when she’s forced to pitch against her boyfriend at the baseball game.

videos.title: A Baby Tooth and the Egyptian God of Knowledge
videos.overview: Sheldon has a scientific breakthrough at the dentist's office. Also, Dale and Connie go to the casino, and Georgie makes a big mistake when Dale leaves him in charge of the store

videos.title: A Secret Letter and a Lowly Disc of Processed Meat
videos.overview: Sheldon discovers that Mary's been keeping a secret about his future. Also, Connie is furious when she learns Dale fired Georgie.

videos.title: Graduation
videos.overview: After graduating high school, Sheldon has a breakdown when he realizes he may not be ready for college. Dale tries to make amends with Connie.

videos.title: A Docent, A Little Lady and a Bouncer Named Dalton
videos.overview: Sheldon gets a summer job at the local train museum. Also, George and Missy bond when Missy embarks on a new stage of womanhood, and Georgie discovers Mary's guilty pleasure.

videos.title: Training Wheels and an Unleashed Chicken
videos.overview: With college in sight, Sheldon is determined to ride his bike without training wheels. Also, Mary and George Sr. argue over parenting styles.

videos.title: Bible Camp and a Chariot of Love
videos.overview: When their mothers force them to attend Vacation Bible School. Also, George is furious after Georgie makes a questionable purchase.

videos.title: A Musty Crypt and a Stick to Pee On
videos.overview: Dale and Connie work out relationship issues while playing Dungeons and Dragons with Sheldon and Missy. Also, Mary and George take a trip with Coach Wilkins and his wife, and Georgie freaks out when his girlfriend thinks she's pregnant.

videos.title: Freshman Orientation and the Inventor of The Zipper
videos.overview: College orientation does not go as Sheldon planned. Also, Mary is invited to a party when she's mistaken for a university student, and George Sr. helps Pastor Jeff set up a children's nursery.

videos.title: A Philosophy Class and Worms That Can Chase You
videos.overview: Sheldon's first day of college is derailed by his new philosophy teacher, Professor Ericson. Also, Mary and Brenda live vicariously through Missy's first day of middle school.

videos.title: An Existential Crisis and a Bear That Makes Bubbles
videos.overview: Connie takes matters into her own hands when Sheldon's philosophy teacher, Professor Ericson, sends him into a tailspin. Also, George Sr. learns Georgie has been cutting class.

videos.title: Crappy Frozen Ice Cream and an Organ Grinder's Monkey
videos.overview: Sheldon and George Sr. dine with President Hagemeyer and a university benefactor. Also, Georgie gives Missy some brotherly advice when Mary won't let her go to the school dance, and Dale and June convince Connie to attend their son's wedding.

videos.title: Cowboy Aerobics and 473 Grease-Free Bolts
videos.overview: Sheldon campaigns to become Dr. Linkletter's lab assistant. Also, Georgie enlists the help of Mr. Lundy, the drama teacher, for a surprising business venture.

videos.title: A Pager, a Club and a Cranky Bag of Wrinkles
videos.overview: Dr. Linkletter pushes Sheldon to make friends with his fellow students at college. Also, Georgie gets a pager.

videos.title: A Box of Treasure and the Meemaw of Science
videos.overview: Sheldon, Dr. Linkletter and Connie team up on a science experiment. Also, Mary is jealous that Pastor Jeff and Brenda are spending time together, and Georgie has a new side hustle.

videos.title: The Geezer Bus and a New Model for Education
videos.overview: Sheldon refuses to ride in a car after getting into an accident with Connie. Also, Missy uses their trauma to her advantage at school and Connie is forced to take the church shuttle while her car is in the shop.

videos.title: Mitch's Son and the Unconditional Approval of a Government Agency
videos.overview: When the IRS accuses Sheldon of making a mistake, he'll stop at nothing to prove them wrong. Also, Dale is forced to get a colonoscopy and tries to convince Connie to join him.

videos.title: A Virus, Heartbreak and a World of Possibilities
videos.overview: Sheldon is caught in a moral dilemma when offered a bootleg copy of a computer game he can't afford. Also, Mary and Connie take Brenda out for girls' night while George Sr. and the guys watch Billy, and Missy asks Georgie to take her and Marcus on a secret date.

videos.title: A Second Prodigy and the Hottest Tips for Pouty Lips
videos.overview: Sheldon finds himself at odds with Paige once again when she considers enrolling at East Texas Tech. Also, Mary seeks June's advice when looking for a change.

videos.title: A Black Hole
videos.overview: The Coopers discuss the possibilities of black holes and alternate universes when Dr. Sturgis comes over for dinner.

videos.title: The Wild and Woolly World of Nonlinear Dynamics
videos.overview: Missy's first heartbreak triggers a series of events that lead the Cooper family to the brink.

videos.title: One Bad Night and Chaos of Selfish Desires
videos.overview: Sheldon and Missy both run away from home, and Mary gets upsetting news about George Sr.

videos.title: Snoopin' Around and the Wonder Twins of Atheism
videos.overview: Sheldon encourages Missy to question the Bible. Also, Connie is determined to catch George Sr. in a lie, and Mary helps Pastor Jeff search for a youth pastor.

videos.title: Potential Energy and Hooch on a Park Bench
videos.overview: Sheldon tries to convince Dr. Sturgis to return to the university. Also, Georgie upsets the family when he makes a life-changing decision.

videos.title: Pish Posh and a Secret Back Room
videos.overview: Sheldon, Missy and Georgie adapt to new living arrangements. Also, Connie opens a gambling room.

videos.title: Stuffed Animals and a Sweet Southern Syzygy
videos.overview: Sheldon and Dr. Linkletter struggle to solve an equation. Also, Georgie has a solution for Connie's business woes, and George Sr. gives advice on Missy's love life.

videos.title: Money Laundering and a Cascade of Hormones
videos.overview: Missy asks some uncomfortable questions at church, and Connie and Georgie go into business together.

videos.title: An Introduction to Engineering and a Glob of Hair Gel
videos.overview: Sheldon takes his first engineering class with Professor Boucher. Also, Meemaw and Dale help take care of his ex-wife, June.

videos.title: The Grand Chancellor and a Den of Sin
videos.overview: Sheldon battles President Hagemeyer's mysterious boss over the university's science requirements. Also, Mary discovers that Georgie is working at Connie's illegal gambling room.

videos.title: The Yips and an Oddly Hypnotic Bohemian
videos.overview: Sheldon gets the science yips and has to learn how to not think. Also, George Sr. plays handyman at Brenda Sparks' house.

videos.title: An Expensive Glitch and a Goof-Off Room
videos.overview: Sheldon gets a dorm room all to himself. Also, Connie gains an unwanted business partner.

videos.title: A Lock-In, a Weather Girl and a Disgusting Habit
videos.overview: Sheldon acts as Mary's spy during a youth lock-in at church. Also, Georgie is attracted to an older woman, Mandy.

videos.title: A Pink Cadillac and a Glorious Tribal Dance
videos.overview: Sheldon attends his first comic book convention; Mary tries selling makeup.

videos.title: A Lot of Band-Aids and the Cooper Surrender
videos.overview: Sheldon makes friends with his dorm neighbors; George Sr. learns his job is in jeopardy.

videos.title: A Free Scratcher and Feminine Wiles
videos.overview: Sheldon butts heads with Dr. Lee, a new scientist in the lab. Also, Mary is given a lotto ticket.

videos.title: A Lobster, an Armadillo and a Way Bigger Number
videos.overview: Sheldon joins Dr. Linkletter and Dr. Sturgis on a science road trip. Also, Georgie continues to lie about his age.

videos.title: A Suitcase Full of Cash and a Yellow Clown Car
videos.overview: Connie's gambling room is a success, and Sheldon dips his toe in the stock market. Also, Missy starts a business.

videos.title: A Solo Peanut, a Social Butterfly and the Truth
videos.overview: Sheldon gets an odd request from an old friend, Paige. Also, George Sr. and Mary are caught in the middle of Connie and Dale's breakup, and Georgie comes clean to Mandy.

videos.title: Babies, Lies and a Resplendent Cannoli
videos.overview: Sheldon copes with the death of a hero. Also, Missy wants to babysit, and Georgie struggles with his big secret.

videos.title: A God-Fearin' Baptist and a Hot Trophy Husband
videos.overview: George and Mary insist on meeting the new woman in Georgie's life. Also, Sheldon and Missy have suspicions about what's going on with their family.

videos.title: Uncle Sheldon and a Hormonal Firecracker
videos.overview: Sheldon and Missy learn about Georgie's pregnancy, and the whole family promises to keep it a secret.

videos.title: White Trash, Holy Rollers and Punching People
videos.overview: As the church congregation gossips about Georgie, Missy stands up for her brother, and Sheldon is distracted by the family drama.

videos.title: Clogged Pore, a Little Spanish and the Future
videos.overview: Sheldon struggles to cope with the first signs of puberty. Also, Mary and George Sr. hunt for new jobs, and Georgie and Meemaw take a business trip across the border.

videos.title: Four Hundred Cartons of Undeclared Cigarettes and a Niblingo
videos.overview: George Sr. bails Connie and Georgie out of jail. Also, Sheldon and Missy meet Mandy, and Mary feels unwelcome at church.

videos.title: Future Worf and the Margarita of the South Pacific
videos.overview: Sheldon and Missy try to help the family’s finances. Also, Mary struggles to find her footing without the church.

videos.title: Passion's Harvest and a Sheldocracy
videos.overview: Sheldon must choose sides in an ethical dilemma. Also, Mary tries her hand at writing and Mandy needs a new place to live.

videos.title: Blonde Ambition and the Concept of Zero
videos.overview: Sheldon makes a terrifying mathematical discovery while tutoring Billy. Also, Mary is jealous of Missy's relationship with Mandy and Connie.

videos.title: A Resident Advisor and the Word 'Sketchy'
videos.overview: At college, Sheldon decides to expand his responsibilities and become a dorm resident advisor. Also, Connie and Dale make a sketchy business deal, and Mary and George Sr. rekindle their romance.

videos.title: An Ugly Car, an Affair and Some Kickass Football
videos.overview: George Sr. is asked to help with the football team. Also, Mandy discovers Georgie and Connie's secret business.

videos.title: A Tougher Nut and a Note on File
videos.overview: Sheldon's search for a comic book leads him to a breakthrough. Also, Georgie and Mandy have an uncomfortable first encounter with her parents, Jim and Audrey.

videos.title: Legalese and a Whole Hoo-Ha
videos.overview: Sheldon's database invention puts him at odds with the university. Also, the church takes issue with Connie's video store.

videos.title: College Dropouts and the Medford Miracle
videos.overview: Sheldon considers dropping out of college to focus on building his database. Also, George Sr. is frustrated when someone else gets credit for his football wins.

videos.title: Pancake Sunday and Textbook Flirting
videos.overview: Mary struggles to make new friends while Mandy pushes Georgie to date another woman.

videos.title: Ruthless, Toothless and a Week of Bed Rest
videos.overview: Sheldon learns the university is building a database without him. Also, Mary takes care of a bedridden Mandy and Meemaw.

videos.title: A Baby Shower and a Testosterone-Rich Banter
videos.overview: Mary butts heads with Mandy's mother, Audrey, and Sheldon attempts male bonding.

videos.title: A Frat Party, a Sleepover and the Mother of All Blisters
videos.overview: Paige drags Sheldon to a college party and Missy gets caught in a lie.

videos.title: A Launch Party and a Whole Human Being
videos.overview: The Coopers can't be found as Mandy goes into labor. Also, Sheldon is excited about the launch of his database.

videos.title: Teen Angst and a Smart-Boy Walk of Shame
videos.overview: Sheldon confronts the failure of his database. Also, Georgie and Mandy struggle as new parents and Missy feels forgotten.

videos.title: A Stolen Truck and Going on the Lam
videos.overview: Missy steals her dad's truck and hits the road with her friend Paige.

videos.title: A German Folk Song and an Actual Adult
videos.overview: Georgie goes on a birthday date and Mary confronts Brenda about her relationship with George. Also, Sheldon takes an interest in Missy's favorite TV show.

videos.title: Little Green Men and a Fella's Marriage Proposal
videos.overview: Sheldon wants to search for life on other planets and Mandy answers Georgie's marriage proposal. Also, Missy is caught between two friends.

videos.title: A New Weather Girl and a Stay-at-Home Coddler
videos.overview: Mandy gets an exciting job opportunity and Sheldon worries that he's falling behind. Also, Georgie takes his daughter to work.

videos.title: German for Beginners and a Crazy Old Man with a Bat
videos.overview: The gambling room gets broken into and Sheldon wants to study abroad. Also, Missy makes a new friend.

videos.title: A Romantic Getaway and a Germanic Meat-Based Diet
videos.overview: Mandy surprises Georgie with a spa weekend and Sheldon prepares for his summer in Germany.

videos.title: A Tornado, a 10-Hour Flight and a Darn Fine Ring
videos.overview: Sheldon and Mary head to Germany while the rest of the Cooper family braves a tornado that is heading straight for Medford.

videos.title: A Wiener Schnitzel and Underwear in a Tree
videos.overview: News of the tornado reaches Sheldon and Mary in Germany. Also, with the Cooper house in chaos, Missy steps up.

videos.title: A Roulette Wheel and a Piano Playing Dog
videos.overview: Sheldon realizes he is the weakest student in his class; Meemaw is looking to expand her gambling business.

videos.title: A Strudel and a Hot American Boy Toy
videos.overview: Sheldon explores Germany behind Mary's back, Missy attempts to pull a fast one on George Sr. and Meemaw and Dale adjust to living together.

videos.title: Ants on a Log and a Cheating Winker
videos.overview: Missy steps up, Mary has a surprise for George, and Sheldon finds his dorm occupied.

videos.title: A Frankenstein's Monster and a Crazy Church Guy
videos.overview: Sheldon helps his roommate try to beat the stock market, Missy and Billy Sparks throw a party, and Mary finds a new church.

videos.title: Baptists, Catholics and an Attempted Drowning
videos.overview: Georgie and Mandy's wedding plans pit Mary against Mandy's mom, Audrey, with baby CeeCee caught in the middle.

videos.title: A Proper Wedding and Skeletons in the Closet
videos.overview: Georgie and Mandy get married! Meanwhile, Meemaw's gambling room gets raided.

videos.title: An Ankle Monitor and a Big Plastic Crap House
videos.overview: Sheldon studies to be Meemaw's lawyer when she is put on house arrest, and the Coopers have a plumbing emergency.

videos.title: A Fancy Article and a Scholarship for a Baby
